title: How to Win Arguments Without Losing Friends with Jessica Tarlov and David Toledo
summary:
Jessica Tarlov and David Toledo dive into Jessica’s upcoming book "I Disagree: Winning Arguments Without Losing Friends. Jessica shares practical tips for navigating disagreements, having better political conversations, and making your point without blowing up your relationships.

"I DISAGREE" IS AVAILABLE ON SEPTEMBER 15th! Pre-order here: https://sites.prh.com/idisagree
